Use case: stylized-concept. NEW KFB historical military ink-monster family. Exactly SIX complete unique cartoon-claymation ink blob monsters in a LANDSCAPE 1536x1024 transparent PNG,3 columns x2rows. Reference1 STYLE ONLY for rounded continuous footless ink body and soft plasticine material; reference2 STYLE ONLY for rich sculpted accessory craft. NOT source identities or repeated grins or red eyeballs. Continuous charcoal-black goo body, subtle deep violet sheen, thick soft rounded asymmetrical splat lobes and a few rounded ink droplets. Huge expressive face directly in blob, short goo hands, upright camera-facing. No human torso, legs, feet, bust crops or humanoid action figures. Fine clay fingerprints and thick handmade fabric, leather, metal. Not generic glossy Pixar people; weird, offbeat and tragically relatable military-bureaucracy satire. WHITE/IVORY sclera, RED iris, BLACK pupil, purple eyelids fully filled. Eyes never hidden by hats or goggles. Exactly two female-read through subtle lids/lashes, no human anatomy. Teeth only INSIDE mouth descending from upper gum, never on outer lower lip; closed mouths toothless. Each1–2dominant accessory anchors, body remains visible. Historical visual inspiration, not exact reenactment. No text/lettering/numbers, flags, political emblems, extremist insignia, eagle badges, skull badges, slogans, propaganda or heroic leader portraits. Plain fictional uniforms. No blood/battle scene. Weapons are simple inert period props held safely beside figure; not firing/aiming toward camera.
Family: Spanisch inspirierter Trupp. Palette and costume: Spanish Civil War/interwar-era inspired army archetype mixture in dusty khaki and olive, not a WWII combatant faction or one documented historical unit; blank uniforms and headgear.
TOP LEFT — Sargento Nochunterwegs; maennlich-read; broad stout ink splat, dusty khaki sidecap with plain short tassel, whistle and folded map; indignant huge asymmetrical open bellow with two upper teeth. Personality: Can rally a whole corridor without finding the correct exit.
TOP MIDDLE — Enlace Umweg; weiblich-read; tall twisting comma blob, soft olive beret, tiny dispatch satchel and compact rolled message; lashes, alarmed huge unequal eyes, tiny toothless sideways mouth. Personality: Carries urgent news that changes while she is carrying it.
TOP RIGHT — Infante Nochhier; maennlich-read; low pear splat, plain rounded steel helmet, canvas blanket roll and short wood-stock rifle safely vertical; one heavy lid, one suspicious raised brow, deep toothless pout. Personality: Holds his position until someone explains which position they mean.
BOTTOM LEFT — Mecánica Buenarueda; weiblich-read; round wide lopsided blob, plain work cap, goggles above eyes, short canvas bib patch and thick spanner; subtle lashes, delighted crooked grin with one upper tooth. Personality: Fixes the transport and refuses to fix the official explanation.
BOTTOM MIDDLE — Oficial Vielleichtdoch; maennlich-read; tall top-heavy blob with plain khaki peaked cap, compact binoculars and little map case; baffled cross-eyed scrutiny and small open oval mouth without teeth. Personality: Has a clear view of everything except his next decision.
BOTTOM RIGHT — Camillero Sachtjetzt; maennlich-read; round drooping blob, khaki cloth cap with small ivory medical plus, medical satchel and bandage roll; concerned heavy eyelids and closed wavy toothless lips. Personality: Believes recovery starts when everybody stops giving advice.
COMPOSITION: Three columns,two rows. Equal substantial body scale, complete uncropped silhouettes and props each within about460x440px cell. Uniform visible heights across rows.32px clear transparent row/column gutters and generous outer margin. Do not overlap characters. All six self-contained,no floor,ground disc,backdrop,scenery,text,labels,border or gridlines. True transparent alpha.
